# nosuchmachine.net — BLACKSITE

> nosuchmachine.net is a working penetration-testing bench and a web operating system, built by NIGHTWARE LABZ. It is a tool, not a brochure: everything on the site runs in the visitor's browser or at the site's guarded edge. Doctrine: one knock, read, grade. Public targets only — private, loopback, and reserved addresses are refused before contact.

## The site

- [BLACKSITE OS](https://nosuchmachine.net/): a windowed operating system in a browser tab — the nightjar Blacksite console ported to the web. Real shell, persistent virtual filesystem, 427 commands, eight programming engines (Python, JavaScript, Lua, SQLite, Scheme, Brainfuck, WebAssembly, CHIP-8), git and SSH clients, EMCON gating, themes and generated wallpapers.
- [Bench suite](https://nosuchmachine.net/bench/): BLACKSITE WEB — DNS resolution across three resolvers, hand-rolled TLS inspection, HTTP security grading, TCP connect checks, RDAP/CT domain recon, email security grading (SPF/DMARC/DKIM/MTA-STS), subdomain census, a PQC migration scanner, JWT inspection and HS verification, an AES-GCM vault, a certificate decoder, codecs, subnet math, and a session report with JSON/Markdown export.
- Relay: a real IRC client built into BLACKSITE OS (OFTC, Libera.Chat, hackint over TLS via the site's bridge). The community channel is #nosuchmachine on OFTC — no account or registration: opening Relay drops visitors straight into the room as guests. Libera.Chat currently refuses bridged guests (it demands SASL from the bridge's network range). House names (nightwarelabz, nosuchmachine, chasebryan and kin) are claimed and open only with the operator's claim code.
- [Orange Book](https://nosuchmachine.net/book/): the book of Orange, a programming language for specifying, implementing, and verifying cryptography — 24 chapters, free to read.
- [Projects](https://nosuchmachine.net/projects/orange/): the NIGHTWARE LABZ catalog — nightjar (the native iOS/macOS network instrument this site ports), orange, snoot (a post-quantum crypto inventory scanner), Magic Box, and more.

## Rules of the house

- Network probes run only against public targets; the edge guard refuses private, loopback, link-local, and reserved space before any packet.
- The bench reads and grades. It does not exploit, spray, brute-force, or flood.
- Tools that cannot honestly run in a browser are named limits, never faked.
